title: Master I built an AI music generator with some harnesses
objectives: Generate your first song from a text prompt
Use prompt settings like genre, mood, and tempo to steer output
Run the provided harnesses to batch-generate and evaluate songs

modules.title: Setup and First Song
steps: Install or launch the app, confirm the audio output folder is set, and open the main prompt screen
Type a simple prompt like 'a lo-fi hip hop track with soft piano and rain sounds' and click Generate
Play the result in the built-in preview player and save it to your library

modules.title: Writing Better Prompts
steps: Add genre, mood, instrument, and tempo descriptors to your prompt (e.g., 'upbeat synth-pop, 120 BPM, female vocals')
Generate 3 variations of the same prompt using the variation button and compare which descriptors had the most effect
Save your best-performing prompt as a reusable template in the prompt library

modules.title: Using the Batch Harness
steps: Create a CSV or text file with 5-10 prompts, one per line, following the harness's expected format
Run the batch harness command (or the 'Batch' tab in the UI) and point it at your prompts file
Open the output folder and confirm each prompt produced an audio file and a metadata log

modules.title: Using the Evaluation Harness
steps: Point the evaluation harness at a folder of generated songs from the previous module
Read the harness's report (scores for prompt match, audio quality, or duration) and identify your weakest prompt
Rewrite that one prompt, regenerate the song, and re-run the harness to compare scores

modules.title: Exporting and Sharing
steps: Pick your best song and export it in your preferred format (e.g., MP3 for sharing, WAV for editing)
Rename the exported file using the metadata from the generation log (title, prompt, date)
Set default export settings so future generations save in your chosen format automatically

title: Master Headless Tools
objectives: Navigate the Headless Tools directory and filter by category
Evaluate a listing for agent-readiness (docs, auth, machine-readable specs)
Integrate one directory tool into an AI agent via function calling

modules.title: Find and Shortlist Tools
steps: Open headless.tools and filter the directory by one category you'll actually use (e.g., email, payments, or web scraping)
Open 3 listings and record each tool's base API URL, auth method, and free tier limits in a notes file
Discard any listing whose docs require a human UI flow (OAuth consent screens you can't automate, dashboard-only config)

modules.title: Assess Agent-Readiness
steps: For each shortlisted tool, check its docs for an OpenAPI spec, MCP server, or structured JSON error responses — note which exist
Read the rate limits and webhook docs; write down how an agent would retry a 429 and verify a webhook signature
Pick a winner by scoring the 3 tools 1-5 on spec availability, error format, and idempotency-key support

modules.title: Test the API Headlessly
steps: Sign up for your chosen tool, mint an API key, and store it in a .env file (never hardcode it)
Run the docs' 'hello world' endpoint with curl, piping the response through jq to confirm the JSON shape matches the docs
Deliberately send one malformed request and one request without the key; confirm both return machine-readable error codes

modules.title: Wire It Into an Agent
steps: Write a JSON-schema function definition (name, description, parameters) that wraps the endpoint you tested
Register the function with your agent framework (OpenAI tools, Anthropic tool use, or LangChain) and run a prompt that triggers it
Add a guardrail: cap calls per run, and log the agent's raw tool-call arguments for one test session to catch hallucinated parameters

prerequisites: Comfortable with REST APIs, JSON, and curl or an HTTP client
Understand API key auth and environment variables
Have built at least a basic AI agent or chatbot with tool/function calling

title: Master CanvasForMusic
objectives: Build a seamless 3–8 second vertical looping video in CanvasForMusic
Export an MP4 that meets Spotify Canvas specs (9:16, 1080x1920)
Upload and publish the Canvas on a track via Spotify for Artists

modules.title: Set Up Your Canvas Project
steps: Sign up for a free CanvasForMusic account and click 'New Canvas' to open a 9:16 (1080x1920) project
Drag in your own video clip or pick one from the built-in stock library that matches your track's mood
Name the project after your song so exports stay organized when you make canvases for multiple tracks

modules.title: Trim and Perfect the Loop
steps: Drag the timeline handles to select the 3–8 second segment with the strongest motion (performance, visual hook, or beat-matched movement)
Choose a loop style: 'Boomerang' for a palindrome loop or 'Crossfade' to blend the end back into the start, then scrub the loop point until no jump is visible
Press the loop preview button and watch it repeat 5+ times to confirm the seam is invisible on a phone-sized preview

modules.title: Export and Publish to Spotify
steps: Click Export and select the 'Spotify Canvas' preset (MP4, H.264, 9:16) to guarantee the file passes Spotify's upload checks
Log into Spotify for Artists, go to Music, pick the track, click 'Add Canvas', and upload the exported MP4
Review the mobile preview in the app, submit, and check back within a few days to confirm the Canvas is live and looping correctly

title: Master The AI Health Agent That Will Know Me for Life
objectives: Summarize the essay's core thesis about a lifelong, data-tracking AI health agent
Identify the specific health data categories the envisioned agent would monitor
Assess your own health-data footprint and the privacy trade-offs of such an agent

modules.title: First Read: Locate the Thesis
steps: Read only the introduction and conclusion; write the author's main claim about lifelong AI health agents in one sentence
Skim the remaining sections and list the three boldest predictions the essay makes about what this agent will do

modules.title: Map the Agent's Data Diet
steps: Reread the essay and highlight every data source the agent would track (wearables, lab results, genomics, medical records, sleep, diet, symptoms)
Build a two-column table with at least 6 rows: data type in column one, what the agent learns or does with it in column two

modules.title: Audit Your Own Health Data
steps: List every place your health data currently lives (patient portal like MyChart, Apple Health/Google Fit, fitness tracker, DNA test, pharmacy records)
Open one source and actually view or export a record, e.g., download your latest lab result from your provider's portal

modules.title: Privacy and Trust Check
steps: Note where the essay addresses (or ignores) data ownership, consent, and who profits from your lifelong record
Draft three non-negotiable questions you would ask before handing your lifetime health data to any AI agent

title: Master Launch HN: Vendo (YC S26)
objectives: Embed the Vendo agent into an existing web app
Expose your product's API as safe, agent-callable tools
Configure auth, guardrails, and ship to production

modules.title: Install and embed the agent
steps: Run `npm install @vendo/agent` and add `<VendoAgent apiKey={...} userToken={...} />` to your app's root layout
Generate a project API key from the Vendo dashboard and store it in your env file
Verify the agent chat widget renders and responds in your dev environment

modules.title: Define tools the agent can call
steps: Write a tools manifest (vendo.tools.ts) mapping tool names to your existing REST endpoints, e.g. `createInvoice`, `listProjects`
Add JSON Schema definitions for each tool's inputs so the agent can validate user requests
Mark read-only vs. write tools and flag destructive actions for user confirmation

modules.title: Wire up user auth and permissions
steps: Implement the server-side session endpoint that signs short-lived user tokens with your Vendo secret
Pass the signed token into the widget so the agent acts only within that user's permissions
Test that the agent cannot access another user's data by switching accounts in dev

modules.title: Test, set guardrails, and deploy
steps: Use Vendo's sandbox replay view to inspect agent traces and confirm correct tool calls on 3 realistic user tasks
Configure rate limits and blocked topics in the dashboard guardrails panel
Promote the config from staging to production and monitor the first week via the analytics tab

prerequisites: A running web app with user authentication
Existing REST API endpoints the agent can call
A Vendo account with dashboard access
